subject: CYCLE-1 TEST-RESULT: Chat pin/archive are host UI features but not agent-callable lifecycle actions
body: Cycle 1 host-capability revalidation corrects the Shadow Trial's coarse UNSUPPORTED classification. Current ChatGPT product documentation confirms pinned chats and manual archiving exist as host/UI features, while this research execution surface exposes no callable current-chat pin/archive action, no guaranteed session-end callback, no exact pre-first-turn role-context injection primitive, and no exact chat-identity restore primitive. Therefore pin/archive should be classified on two axes: host_feature=HOST_SUPPORTED, agent_invocation=AGENT_NOT_EXPOSED. Safe result when desired is MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED, never VERIFIED. Exact verified role packages remain usable through post-start AGENT_DISCOVERY bootstrap; that must not be mislabeled pre-prompt injection.
